available.quote: The board shall issue an electrical license by endorsement in this state to any person who is licensed to practice in another jurisdiction if the person presents proof satisfactory to the board that, at the time of application for a Colorado license by endorsement, the person possesses credentials and qualifications that are substantially equivalent to requirements in Colorado for licensure.

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement requires substantially equivalent credentials and qualifications; licensure by reciprocity requires a reciprocal agreement with the other state's electrical board where qualifications are substantially equivalent to Colorado's.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue an electrical license by reciprocity where a reciprocal agreement for an equivalent license exists, pursuant to section 12-115-107 (2)(i), between the board and the electrical board, or its equivalent, of the state or states where the applicant is licensed.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices or offers or attempts to practice the profession of an electrician without an active license issued under this article 115 is subject to penalties pursuant to section 12-20-407 (1)(a).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or aiding/abetting violation of any provision of article 115 or applicable provision of article 20, or violation of board rules or orders.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of or aiding or abetting in the violation of any of the provisions of this article 115 or an applicable provision of article 20 of this title 12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to remove within a reasonable time the cause of disapproval of any electrical installation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to remove within a reasonable time the cause of the disapproval of any electrical installation as reported on the notice of disapproval

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to maintain or adhere to the minimum standards set forth in board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to maintain or adhere to the minimum standards set forth in rules adopted by the board pursuant to section 12-115-107 (2)(a)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any cause for which issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any cause for which the issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commitment of one or more acts or omissions that do not meet generally accepted standards of electrical practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commitment of one or more acts or omissions that do not meet generally accepted standards of electrical practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or acceptance of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising by any licensee or registrant that is false or misleading.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising by any licensee or registrant that is false or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Deception, misrepresentation, or fraud in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employment of any person required to be licensed, registered, or to obtain a permit who has not obtained the license, registration, or permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employment of any person required by this article 115 to be licensed or registered or to obtain a permit who has not obtained the license, registration, or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action against an electrician's license or registration in another jurisdiction.

Evidence of the disciplinary action shall be prima facie evidence for denial of licensure or registration or other disciplinary action if the violation would be grounds for disciplinary action in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false information to the board during an investigation with the intent to deceive or mislead.
